title: GET /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/waf/exceptions: result
description: The exceptions the cluster's objects carry, with what each let through over the last days.

days.description: Value. How many days back the counts reach.

object.description: Value. The object that carries the exception.

rule.description: Value. The rule set's number for the rule the exception lets through.

kind.description: Text. The page's name for the kind of attack the rule's file covers. Match on rule instead.

explanation.description: Text. The page's sentence on that kind.

message.description: Text. The rule set's own message for the rule.

severity.description: Code. The rule set's severity for the rule; empty where the installed rule set does not define it.

field.description: Value. The part of the request the exception is limited to, in the engine's name for it, such as ARGS:q; null where it covers every part.

paths.description: Value. The paths the exception is limited to; empty where it covers every path.

reason.description: Value. The reason written with the exception; null where none was.

added_by.description: Value. Who added it; null where not recorded.

added_at.description: Value. When it was added; null where not recorded.

in_draft.description: Value. True where it was made in the draft and is not yet published.

not_working.description: Value. True where the rule still matched what the exception covers after it reached the nodes.

let_through.description: What the exception let through over the period.

counted.description: Value. Whether the engine counts what this exception lets through; false means requests and clients are not measured.

requests.description: Value. How many requests it let through.

clients.description: Value. How many clients made them.

last_seen.description: Value. When a request last passed through it; null where none did or it is not counted.
